company_name: Atomic Nano Materials and Equipment Co.,Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-end semiconductor coating equipment, including ALD and EPI equipment.
summary: Atomic Nano Materials and Equipment Co., Ltd. focuses on the development and production of advanced semiconductor coating equipment, particularly atomic layer deposition (ALD) and silicon-germanium epitaxy (EPI) systems. With a commitment to innovation and customization, the company aims to establish itself as a leading supplier in the semiconductor equipment market.

regional_presence.China: The company has established subsidiaries in Xuzhou and Jiangsu for assembly and precision manufacturing, respectively, and a global sales network through its Singapore subsidiary.
